title: Qualify judges blind
statement: Qualify anyone whose judgments will set a standard on a fresh blind test, because familiarity is not qualification.
detail: After two qualification rounds for people who would judge a reading gold set failed, the record says familiarity with the project is not automatic qualification: a new blind result must show competence. The role rule it recommends has two people review independently and blind, a third qualified person adjudicate and a fourth sign any release. An agent-routing plan for the same course adds that no lane can certify the whole course by itself. Keep reviewing, adjudicating and signing off in separate hands, so that no one, person or agent, certifies their own work.
